what_changed_today: THE SHELF BROKE UPWARD: close 7,798.99 (+0.65% vs 7,748.50) is a new all-time closing high that clears the seven-session 7,700-7,794 distribution shelf and the old 7,793.68 intraday high; a fresh anchor at 7,816.70 (2026-08-13) is set but still 'unconfirmed_new_high'.

MONTE CARLO EDGE JUMPED TO THE STRONGEST READING OF THE ENTIRE ARC AND FINALLY CLEARS THE 70% LATE BULL BAR: adjusted prob_up_first 72.86% (raw 77.86%) vs 27.14% down-first, median 2d up vs 11d down, probability_regime 'upside_tilt' — the first actionable-by-threshold reading after fifteen consecutive failures.

EXTENSION PUSHED INTO THE ELEVATED BAND: +10.31% above the 200-day (from +9.67%), the highest of the arc, with rally exhaustion held at Moderate (5% upside discount) and price riding/piercing the upper Bollinger band on the 1-month and 5-day charts.

PARTICIPATION STILL WILL NOT CONFIRM: net new 52-week highs have sagged to 0.92 (score 30) at a record close while McClellan has mean-reverted back to only ~1,030 — the same narrow-leadership profile that has accompanied the whole advance.

SENTIMENT PUSHED BACK INTO GREED WITH VOLATILITY AT A YEAR LOW: F&G 66 (near the top of its one-year range), VIX 14.63 far below its ~17.2 50-day MA, put/call 0.69 at its one-year mean — complacent conditions that remove any capitulation-style re-entry trigger.
narrative_summary: The seven-session distribution shelf resolved upward: SPX closed at a record 7,798.99, up 0.65%, in the top third of its range, and the Monte Carlo edge simultaneously surged to 72.86% adjusted up-first — the first reading of this arc to clear the governing 70% Late Bull threshold. But the internals that have lagged all month still lag: net new 52-week highs sagged to 0.92 at a record close, McClellan is only back to ~1,030 after cycle lows, extension is now +10.31% above the 200-day, and ERP at 0.29% sits inside the valuation-ceiling band with the ERP-confirmed re-entry floor 4.1% below spot. Credit is the cleanest bull evidence — junk spreads at a year-low 1.22 — while VIX 14.63 signals complacency, not fear. Posture stays trim-into-strength: honor the breakout by not shorting it, use the 7,817–7,915 zone to lighten, and wait for the 7,698/7,625 fib shelf or the 50-day at ~7,508 before any re-entry work.
open_questions: Does the fresh 7,816.70 anchor confirm with a second qualifying close, or does today's breakout fail back into the 7,700-7,794 shelf and complete the distribution top?
Can breadth (net new 52-week highs at 0.92, McClellan ~1,030) expand to validate a record close, or does narrow leadership cap the advance near the 7,817-7,915 cascade band?
With ERP pinned at 0.29% and forward PE 20.28x, does the next leg require multiple expansion the valuation ceiling cannot support without further EPS upgrades?
Does the first 70%-clearing Monte Carlo edge of the arc justify a tactical exception, or does Late Bull discipline still require breadth/ERP confirmation before any deployment?

conflicting_evidence.bullish_read: Price made a new all-time closing high with a top-third close and McClellan has recovered off its cycle low to ~1,030, which can be the early stage of genuine breadth repair following the leadership.
conflicting_evidence.bearish_read: Net new 52-week highs have deteriorated to 0.92 (score 30), the weakest of the year, while McClellan is merely mean-reverting inside a participation downtrend — a record price on shrinking participation is textbook narrow leadership.
conflicting_evidence.framework_rule: When breadth and credit both diverge from price, elevate caution even if price has not yet broken down; headline strength with weak breadth indicates narrow leadership.

conflicting_evidence.bullish_read: Forward EPS keeps rising (384.63) and forward PE 20.28x is only at the low end of the cautious band, so the breakout is earnings-supported rather than purely multiple-driven.
conflicting_evidence.bearish_read: ERP is 0.29% — inside the 0.0-0.5% valuation-ceiling band with a stable trend and 10-year at 4.641% — meaning trim bias and no aggressive adds; the ERP-confirmed re-entry floor sits at 7,481.62, some 4.1% below spot.
conflicting_evidence.framework_rule: ERP 0.0% to 0.5% = valuation ceiling: trim bias, no aggressive adds. Forward PE 20x-22x = cautious buying only at strong confluence.

conflicting_evidence.bullish_read: 5-day MFI has turned up off the ~22 Aug 6 buy-watch low toward ~49 and daily MFI holds ~69-70, so flow is improving alongside the breakout.
conflicting_evidence.bearish_read: Price is at a new all-time high while 5-day MFI (~49) is far below its ~91 Aug 4 peak set at a lower price — a multi-session bearish money-flow divergence that has never resolved, and daily RSI never regained its early-August ~84 peak.
conflicting_evidence.framework_rule: Bearish divergence: price makes a higher high while MFI or RSI makes a lower high; longer timeframe divergences carry more weight.

conflicting_evidence.bullish_read: VIX 14.63 below its 50-day, put/call 0.69 at the one-year mean and F&G 66 short of euphoric extremes describe an orderly, low-stress uptrend that supports tighter probability ranges and the high up-first reading.
conflicting_evidence.bearish_read: VIX at a one-year low with price +10.31% above the 200-day is complacency at maximum extension; no volatility spike means any decline will be orderly rather than capitulative, removing the highest-quality re-entry trigger and leaving upside probabilities to be discounted for Moderate exhaustion.
conflicting_evidence.framework_rule: VIX below 15 = complacent regime; a correction without a volatility spike should be treated as orderly rather than capitulative. Above 15% / 10-15% extension, drift benefit is meaningfully reduced and mean-reversion pressure is elevated.

conflicting_evidence.bullish_read: The intraday print of 7,816.70 re-anchored the swing high on a strong closing basis, and the shelf resolution upward argues the base is complete.
conflicting_evidence.bearish_read: The new anchor is 'unconfirmed_new_high' (anchor_version=2); a single session above a seven-session distribution shelf can still fail back inside, and the previous anchor spent seven sessions unconfirmed before this attempt.
conflicting_evidence.framework_rule: A single new-high session is provisional until confirmed (two qualifying closes total); a failed breakout retains the previously confirmed anchors.

primary_tension: The first genuinely actionable probability reading of the entire arc (72.86% adjusted up-first, clearing the 70% Late Bull bar) arrived on a record top-third close that finally broke the seven-session shelf — but it is colliding with the same late-cycle skeleton that has capped every prior attempt: extension pushed to +10.31% above the 200-day into the elevated band, ERP compressed to 0.29% inside the valuation-ceiling zone with the re-entry floor 4.1% below spot, net new 52-week highs sagging to 0.92 and McClellan only ~1,030 at an all-time price, a persistent multi-session money-flow divergence (5-day MFI ~49 versus ~91 on Aug 4 at a lower price), and F&G 66 with VIX 14.63 at a one-year low signalling complacency rather than the fear that would make a re-entry high quality.
